row.evidence: Zoho Books' pricing, plan comparison, help centre and API reference describe manual user invites and a REST Users API, but no SCIM provisioning; inbound SCIM is documented only for the separate Zoho One suite.
row.notes: New row. None by absence (rule 5): searched the Zoho Books pricing page and plan comparison, the Books help sitemap (328 URLs) and the Books API reference. Plans are priced per organisation per month with included users (Free 1 user + 1 accountant, Standard $15 annual/$20 monthly 3 users, Professional $40/$50 5 users, Premium $60/$70 10 users, Elite $120/$150 10 users, Ultimate $240/$275 15 users); extra users $2.50/user/month annual. Per-user fields left null. Books pages do not mention SAML; Zoho's SAML setup lives in Zoho Accounts help (help.zoho.com, not machine-verifiable), so sso_plan is null. SCIM into a Zoho org exists only for Zoho One (Entra gallery app, enabled via Zoho One support). The Books REST API (all plans, daily caps by plan) can create, invite, update, deactivate, reactivate and delete users.

scim.notes: Zoho Books documents no SCIM endpoint. Inbound SCIM into a Zoho organisation is documented only for the Zoho One suite (Microsoft Entra gallery app, enabled by Zoho One support), which is a separate product.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per minute per organization; daily caps by plan (1,000/day Free to 10,000/day Premium and above).

user_api.notes: Every request carries organization_id. User endpoints use ZohoBooks.settings.* OAuth scopes (CREATE quoted; READ and UPDATE also shown on the page).

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/zoho-books/ and /zoho/ return 404; an OIN Zoho One app exists but was not treated as a Zoho Books app.

entra.notes: No Zoho Books gallery tutorial found; the Entra gallery has a Zoho One app with SCIM provisioning (c19), which covers the Zoho One suite rather than standalone Zoho Books.

fallbacks.other_sync: Zoho One suite only: SCIM provisioning from Microsoft Entra ID into the Zoho organisation
fallbacks.notes: Zoho Accounts SAML article (help.zoho.com) mentions JIT on SAML sign-in, but the page could only be read through a summariser (renderer and curl got a JS shell), so JIT is left null.
